description: Shared default (untuned) VeloxQ SA config, TFIM 1D, h=0.5, alpha=1 (n_hidden=N). Used by scripts/viz/paper_figures.py for any N with no per-N tuned entry in alpha1_h0.5/manifest.json. sweeps2000 excluded: same (lr, reg, n_samples) on record but a different num_sweeps (SA sweeps per sample), not a repeated seed of this config.
